standard-dialogue.npc: Hello there! Welcome to my special antiques boutique.

steps.npc: I'm a specialist at identifying rare and antique weapons, specifically swords, but I plan to branch out. If you have any old and rusty weapons that you want me to check out, just show them to me, pay me 100 Gold and
I'll see if you have an antique on your hands.
I can also repair some antique weapons and armours, just show me the item and I'll let you know if I can repair it and for how much.

Well, pay me 100 Gold and I'll see if any rusty swords that you've found are actually worth anything. Some of them might be worth some money! If it's an antique item though, I reserve the right to purchase it
immediately for adding to my own personal collection. I'll give you fair price for it.

options.text: What do I get from this?

steps.player: What do I get from this?

steps.npc: If I can reclaim the sword with my own specialist skills, I'll return it to you in peak condition. If it's an antique, I'll just give you what I think it's worth and I generally pay quite well. However, if it's just a piece of junk, I'll
simply give you the bad news and get rid of the item for you.

options.text: Ok, I'll give it a go!

steps.player: Ok, I'll give it a go!

steps.text: If the player has no rusty swords and no rusty scimitars:

steps.npc: Sorry my friend, but you don't seem to have any swords that need to be identified.

steps.text: If the player does not have enough money:

steps.npc: Sorry my friend, but you don't seem to have enough money to cover my fee!

steps.text: If the player has both a rusty sword and rusty scimitar:
Which would you like to identify?
If the player has a rusty sword:
You hand Tindel 100 coins plus the rusty sword.
(Same as rusty sword dialogue.)
If the player has a rusty scimitar:
You hand Tindel 100 coins plus the rusty scimitar.
(Same as rusty scimitar dialogue.)
